subject: Reviewers Required for Packt's new video on R : 'Building Interactive Graphs with ggplot2 and Shiny'

messages.author: 5d7982cf51e87be2
messages.subject: Reviewers Required for Packt's new video on R : 'Building Interactive Graphs with ggplot2 and Shiny'
parts:
Hi All,

Packt is currently engaged in promoting it's latest video courses. We have recently published a Video Course titled - Building Interactive Graphs with GGplot2 and Shiny. We have a few copies of the same available for review. If interested, just drop a line in the comments below with following required details:

1. Email address (for further communication)
2. Choice of website for posting your book-review (can be your blog/website, Dzone.com or on the sample chapter page of the video on YouTube)

You may read more about the video here: http://www.packtpub.com/building-interactive-graphs-with-ggplot2-and-shiny/video

I shall get back to you as quickly as I can. For further queries, please feel free to mail me at oindrilad(at)packtpub(dot)com

Brief overview : Conceived by Christoph Ladroue, this complete guide is for beginners as well as professionals who are interested in building stunning graphics and interactive visuals for real-time data analysis and visualization with ggplot and Shiny. Ggplot2 is one of R’s most popular packages, and is an implementation of the grammar of graphics in R, which is a powerful tool for performing statistical analyses and drawing publication-quality graphics.

(Limited copies available)
